CarbFix工程如何把二氧化碳变成玄武岩里的矿物？这种封存方式为何近乎永久？

How does the CarbFix project turn carbon dioxide into minerals within basalt, and why is this form of storage nearly permanent?

CarbFix先把捕集的CO₂溶入大量水中形成碳酸水，再注入数百米深的玄武岩层。溶解态CO₂化学活性更高，能与岩石中的钙镁硅酸盐快速反应，析出方解石等碳酸盐矿物。注入井的同位素示踪表明，超过95%的CO₂在不到两年内完成矿化，被永久固定为固态碳酸盐，基本消除泄漏风险与后期监测负担；前提是有充足的水与合适岩层。
At CarbFix, captured CO₂ is first dissolved in large volumes of water to form carbonated fluid, then injected several hundred meters down into basaltic rock. Dissolved CO₂ is far more reactive than the supercritical phase: it rapidly reacts with calcium-magnesium silicates in the rock, precipitating calcite and other carbonate minerals. Isotope tracers in monitoring wells showed that over 95% of the injected CO₂ was mineralized in less than two years, permanently locked into solid carbonates and largely free of leakage risk and post-closure monitoring burdens; the method requires ample water and suitable rock formations.

#碳捕集 #矿物封存 #玄武岩

为什么二氧化碳注入地下咸水层封存之前，通常要被压缩到超临界状态？

Why is carbon dioxide usually compressed to a supercritical state before it is injected into deep saline aquifers for geological storage?

超临界二氧化碳（温度高于31.1℃、压力高于7.38兆帕）密度接近液体而黏度接近气体，能以远高于气态的体积效率充填深部咸水层孔隙，大幅提高单位储层的封存量，并降低井筒内的注入压力损耗。入层之后，它经盖层构造圈闭、孔隙残余捕获、溶解与矿化等机制被逐步固定，封存安全性随时间推移而提高。
Supercritical CO₂ (above 31.1 °C and 7.38 MPa) is nearly as dense as a liquid but flows almost like a gas, so it fills deep saline-aquifer pore space with far greater volumetric efficiency than gaseous CO₂, raising storage capacity per reservoir and cutting pressure losses in the well. Underground, it is progressively immobilized by structural trapping beneath the caprock, then by residual, solubility, and mineral trapping, so containment generally improves with time.

#碳捕集 #超临界CO2 #地质封存

二氧化碳注入深部咸水层之后，封存为什么会随时间推移变得愈发牢固？主要依靠哪几类捕集机制？

After CO2 is injected into deep saline formations, why does storage become increasingly secure over time, and which trapping mechanisms are responsible?

注入初期，超临界态二氧化碳被低渗透盖层的构造圈闭拦在上覆地层之下；随后毛管力把它分割成滞留在孔隙中的残余气滴；一部分气体溶入地层水使卤水密度增大而下沉，削弱向上逃逸的浮力驱动；更缓慢的矿物反应还会将少量碳固定为固态碳酸盐。四类机制随时间接力生效，整体泄漏风险逐步下降。
At first, supercritical CO2 is held underground by structural trapping beneath low-permeability caprock. Capillary forces then snap it off into residual droplets stuck within pores. Dissolved CO2 makes brine denser so it sinks, weakening the buoyant drive to escape, and slow geochemical reactions fix a small share of carbon into solid carbonate minerals. These four mechanisms take over in succession, so overall leakage risk declines.
